claims.claim: DPR's Wikipedia retrieval corpus contains 21,015,324 passages
English Wikipedia dump from Dec 20 2018 was the source
DrQA preprocessing code was used to clean the dump
Tables, infoboxes, lists, and disambiguation pages were removed
Each cleaned article was split into disjoint text blocks
Each passage was prepended with the article's title
Each passage was prepended with an [SEP] token
